name: harness-pause-reference-cap

policy.pauseReferences: At most512 immediately previous observed-rAF native actor records; pause-boundary scene and any paused native-frame discrepancy are written with their actual previous-rAF references. New/changed identities use current state.
policy.enemyTransitions: rAF-observed logical state changes only; point observations, not continuous enemy animation
policy.overflow: Stop recorder and reject completeness; never silently discard player/tool frames
policy.encoding: UTF-8 NDJSON, incrementally drained and checked; catalogue records precede their dynamic references

scope: Player/tool at every observed rAF; enemy scenes every100ms plus observed logical transition points. Catalogue definitions precede references. No gameplay mutation.
